mapper.select: SELECT eo.store_id AS "storeId", oi.seller_sku AS "sellerSku", SUM(pi.material_qty) AS "qty" FROM ecom_package p JOIN ecom_package_item pi ON pi.package_id = p.id JOIN ecom_order eo ON eo.id = pi.order_id JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.id = pi.order_item_id WHERE p.status = 'SHIPPED' AND p.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND pi.material_id = #{materialId} AND p.ship_time >= #{begin} AND p.ship_time < #{end} GROUP BY eo.store_id, oi.seller_sku ORDER BY eo.store_id, oi.seller_sku
SELECT l.store_id AS "storeId", l.seller_sku AS "sellerSku" FROM ecom_listing l WHERE l.material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY l.store_id, l.seller_sku

SELECT a.*, s.name AS store_name, o.platform_order_no AS order_no FROM ecom_owh_fee_alloc a LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = a.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = a.order_id WHERE a.fee_id = #{feeId} ORDER BY a.id
